title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 2 Schedule Truth Layer
scope: Build Page 1 upcoming-Sunday NFL schedule truth layer under the frozen Step 1 Prop Analytics route. Reconcile NFL.com, nflverse, and ESPN schedule evidence field-by-field. No player props, odds, projections, Passing Yards changes, or existing NFL market changes.

source_router.verification_rule: Two or more independent sources must agree on matchup and kickoff within 10 minutes for VERIFIED.
source_router.single_source_rule: May display as SOURCE CONFIRMED, never VERIFIED.
source_router.fail_closed_rule: If no real source returns a Sunday slate, display no games and a fail-closed message.

acceptance: Upcoming Sunday slate is sourced from real external schedule evidence.
NFL.com, nflverse, and ESPN are routed independently; no single provider is mandatory for display.
A game is VERIFIED only when at least two independent sources agree and kickoff consensus is within 10 minutes.
Page 1 renders schedule cards with kickoff, teams, network when available, and source provenance.
No fabricated fallback schedule exists; empty-source state fails closed.
Step 1 route owner markers remain present and unchanged.
Frozen Passing Yards files and V239/V240/app entry remain byte-identical.
390/768/1440 Step 2 schedule board has no horizontal overflow.
Public production proof passes before Step 2 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
